title: feat(theme): Emerald Dynasty premium chrome + dashboard + primitives (phases 2-4, consolidated onto main)
body:
## Summary
Consolidates Emerald Dynasty **phases 2–4** into a single PR that applies cleanly on top of current `main`. Phase 1 (#16) is already merged; the original stacked phase PRs (#17/#18/#19) were branched before CSP PR #20 landed, so merging those branches directly would have reverted CSP work. This branch instead cherry-picks only the three theme feature commits onto `main`, touching **only the 9 theme files** (no CSP files).

All styling is additive and gated behind `html[data-brand="emerald"]`, so the classic theme is unchanged until an admin enables Emerald in Admin → Settings → General → Site Appearance.

What's included:
- **Phase 2 — chrome:** `AppHeader`, `AppNav`, `Footer` get stable hooks (`app-header*`, `app-nav__item`, `site-footer*`) styled as luxe header/nav/footer (gold hairlines, royal gradient footer, gold-foil avatar/CTA).
- **Phase 3 — dashboard:** `DashboardContent` root gets `dashboard-premium` + `dashboard-surface`/`dashboard-hero` hooks → layered premium background, glassy cards, royal hero, gold CTAs.
- **Phase 4 — primitives:** `Button`, `Card`, `Input`, `Badge` emit `brand-*` hooks → gold-foil primary buttons, glassy cards, emerald field chrome, jewel-toned badges.
- `styles/emerald-theme.css`: all emerald-scoped rules for the above (+173 lines).

```
diff vs main: 9 files, +226 / -52  (no CSP files touched)
```

### Validation
- `npm run lint` ✅
- `npm run build` ✅ (117 pages)
- Visual checks of chrome + dashboard + primitives in both light/dark emerald via static harnesses loading the real stylesheet.

### Deploy note
No new migrations in this PR (theme reads the existing `active_site_theme` AdminSetting and falls back to `default` if absent). Deploy via the normal `prisma migrate deploy` + build pipeline — no `db push` required.
